# Desktop test fixtures

These public certificates, keys, signatures, and messages are copied from the
client crate's test fixtures so that desktop tests also run from a Cargo source
archive. They contain no private keys and use the project's MIT or Apache-2.0
license. See the [client fixture guide](https://github.com/Juanbanpar/pkcs11-stack/blob/v0.1.0/crates/pkcs11-client/tests/fixtures/README.md)
for their provenance.
